findings.claim: Leaving DELETE on listings unchanged means the destructive route has no auth at all while POST and PATCH do.
findings.recommendation: Gate DELETE with getSession() and role admin.

findings.claim: Magic-link tokens never expire and are kept after use, so a token in an email archive logs the user in indefinitely.
findings.evidence: a nightly job can prune rows older than 90 days
findings.recommendation: Add expires_at and delete or flag the row on first use.

findings.claim: Because the middleware matcher is limited to /admin, the write API routes are not covered and the 'no checks needed' assumption does not hold.
findings.evidence: the API routes do not need their own checks
